title: We Have Come Into His House - Sunday Morning Worship
text: We Have Come Into His House – Sunday Morning Worship🎶 We Have Come Into His House – Sunday Morning Worship 🙌🏠 Join us for a joyful and reverent moment of Sunday morning worship at Walk of Grace Chapel as we sing “We Have Come Into His House.” This classic worship chorus reminds us why we gather together—to worship the Lord, lift up His name, and bow our hearts before Him in praise. This simple yet powerful song calls us to set aside distractions and focus fully on the presence of God, honoring Him with both our voices and our lives. 🎵 “We have come into His house and gathered in His name to worship Him.” 📖 Key Bible Verse: Psalm 95:6 “Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.” Whether you’re worshiping with us in person or online, we pray this moment encourages you to enter God’s presence with humility, joy, and thanksgiving. 🔹 Recorded live during Sunday morning worship 🔹 Classic congregational worship song 🔹 Focused on gathering to honor the Lord 🔹 A reminder of why we come together as the church 💬 What helps you prepare your heart for worship when you gather with God’s people? Share in the comments, and don’t forget to LIKE, SHARE, and SUBSCRIBE for more worship moments from Walk of Grace Chapel. 🔖 Hashtags: #WeHaveComeIntoHisHouse #SundayMorningWorship #WalkOfGraceChapel #PraiseAndWorship #ChristianWorship #ChurchWorship #GatheredToWorship #LiveWorship #FaithSongs Learn more about our music team here: http://www.walkofgrace.com/our-music/ Check out our Praise and Worship Lyric and Chord videos here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLf7dGfjSYJd5a9fLmXm7RfDzNMjwRorOC See our list of original songs here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLf7dGfjSYJd5X_c_-dGN9z64V6WaTHiaD Find out more about us here: Website - http://www.walkofgrace.com Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/WalkOfGrace/ Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/WalkOfGrace/ Twitter - http://twitter.com/WalkofGraceCB Tumblr - https://walkofgrace.tumblr.com/ Walk of Grace Chapel is a non-denominational Christian church located in Council Bluffs, IA. We’re committed to sharing the Gospel of God’s grace through Bible-based teaching, praise and worship music, and a welcoming church family. 📍 To learn more or join us for service, visit: http://www.walkofgrace.com Our Mission Statement: To carry the gospel of grace to the world; to the lost that they might be saved, and to the saved that they might grow strong Are you sure you're going to Heaven? http://www.walkofgrace.com/are-you-sure-youre-a-christian/
